h60: What if your delivery methodology didn't live in documents, but ran inside the work?
It takes three bodies of knowledge, paired correctly.
Accenture's: forty-five nCino engagements, encoded as agents and skills.
The bank's: its own rules, products and live platform.
And nCino's, through the Admin MCP, at every step.
Agents draft. People decide, at discovery and again at code.
Accenture: the first SI partner on the nCino MCP in a live SDLC, with the skilled people to run it.
One month in: three times the tickets each sprint, with stories the same size.
That three times is two stories: twice the user stories, and the bug backlog cleared.
Nothing carried forward. One standard for every developer. Built on what nCino already provides.
Grounded in nCino. Decided by people. Delivered by Accenture.
